description: TRIGGER/RULE/POLICY(RLS)/EVENT TRIGGER acceptance on postgresql17 (#125): trigger lifecycle incl. constraint/event triggers, rewrite rules, row-level security policies and event triggers execute natively.

ddl_steps.name: create schema
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE SCHEMA t42

ddl_steps.name: fixture tables+fn
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE TABLE t42.log (id int, note text); CREATE TABLE t42.src (id int); CREATE FUNCTION t42.logfn() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN INSERT INTO t42.log VALUES (NEW.id, 'trig'); RETURN NEW; END; $$

ddl_steps.name: create trigger
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE TRIGGER t42_trg AFTER INSERT ON t42.src FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION t42.logfn()

ddl_steps.name: create constraint trigger
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER t42_ctrg AFTER INSERT ON t42.src DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION t42.logfn()

ddl_steps.name: trigger fires
ddl_steps.sql: INSERT INTO t42.src VALUES (1)

verify.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM t42.log WHERE note='trig'

ddl_steps.name: alter trigger rename
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER TRIGGER t42_trg ON t42.src RENAME TO t42_trg2

ddl_steps.name: alter trigger depends on extension
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER TRIGGER t42_trg2 ON t42.src DEPENDS ON EXTENSION pg_stat_statements

ddl_steps.name: drop triggers
ddl_steps.sql: DROP TRIGGER t42_trg2 ON t42.src; DROP TRIGGER t42_ctrg ON t42.src

ddl_steps.name: create rule
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE RULE t42_rule AS ON INSERT TO t42.src DO ALSO INSERT INTO t42.log VALUES (NEW.id, 'rule')

ddl_steps.name: rule fires
ddl_steps.sql: INSERT INTO t42.src VALUES (2)

verify.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM t42.log WHERE note='rule'

ddl_steps.name: alter rule rename
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER RULE t42_rule ON t42.src RENAME TO t42_rule2

ddl_steps.name: drop rule
ddl_steps.sql: DROP RULE t42_rule2 ON t42.src

ddl_steps.name: enable row security
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER TABLE t42.src ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY

ddl_steps.name: create policy
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE POLICY t42_pol ON t42.src FOR SELECT TO PUBLIC USING (id > 0)

ddl_steps.name: create policy restrictive
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE POLICY t42_pol_r ON t42.src AS RESTRICTIVE FOR UPDATE TO PUBLIC WITH CHECK (id < 100)

ddl_steps.name: alter policy
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER POLICY t42_pol ON t42.src USING (id >= 0)

ddl_steps.name: alter policy rename
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER POLICY t42_pol ON t42.src RENAME TO t42_pol2

ddl_steps.name: drop policies
ddl_steps.sql: DROP POLICY t42_pol2 ON t42.src; DROP POLICY t42_pol_r ON t42.src

ddl_steps.name: create event trigger fn
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE FUNCTION t42.evtf() RETURNS event_trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN RAISE NOTICE 'ddl'; END; $$

ddl_steps.name: create event trigger
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE EVENT TRIGGER t42_evt ON ddl_command_start EXECUTE FUNCTION t42.evtf()

ddl_steps.name: alter event trigger enable
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER EVENT TRIGGER t42_evt DISABLE; ALTER EVENT TRIGGER t42_evt ENABLE REPLICA; ALTER EVENT TRIGGER t42_evt ENABLE ALWAYS

ddl_steps.name: alter event trigger rename/owner
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER EVENT TRIGGER t42_evt RENAME TO t42_evt2

ddl_steps.name: drop event trigger
ddl_steps.sql: DROP EVENT TRIGGER t42_evt2

ddl_steps.name: drop schema
ddl_steps.sql: DROP SCHEMA t42 CASCADE
